name: Shenma Industry Co.Ltd
summary: Shenma Industry Co.Ltd operates in the chemical and chemical fiber industries in China and internationally. The company offers nylon 66 industrial filament, nylon 66 dipped fabric, nylon 66 chips, adipic acid, airbag yarn, caprolactam, nylon 6 chips, nylon 6 civilian filament, canvas, para-aramid, pc, hexamethylenediamine, and printing and dyeing chemical fiber. It also provides engineering plastics, industrial yarn, and BCF carpet yarn. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Pingdingshan, China. Shenma Industry Co.Ltd operates as a subsidiary of China Pingmei Shenma Holding Group Co.,Ltd.
